attached_bus_headroom.note: Occupancy and curtailment are reported apart and must not be combined. Their correlation over the points where both are known is -0.025: a bus at 10 percent occupancy can still curtail 37 percent of what it carries, because the constraint is upstream.

route_factor.note: Line distances are to the straight segment between a line's terminals, which is all ONS publishes. Multiply by this to approximate the conductor route.

curtailment_at_connected_plants.basis: Withheld energy is the operator's estimated generation minus its verified generation, summed over the plants inside the AOI. The estimate is a model of ONS's, so the difference carries its error and is reported unclipped. The reason and origin are attributed to the CLUSTER a plant belonged to at the time, so they describe plants outside the AOI as well. unrestricted_baseline_fraction is the same difference over the half hours with no restriction in force, at the same plants over the same window: the floor below which this figure is the operator's model error rather than curtailment.
curtailment_at_connected_plants.source: ONS constrained-off, photovoltaic detail and curtailment

grid_congestion.note: Proximity and curtailment are reported apart and must not be summed into a score. A site 1.3 km from a 440 kV line rated 2,664 MVA can still lose 14 percent of its output, because the binding constraint is upstream of the connection.
